children: Australian shares were poised to open higher on Monday, with stronger underlying metal prices expected to boost commodity stocks, while investors weighed the risk of further tightening after the central bank raised interest rates to a 15-year high last week.
The local share price index futures (YAPcm1) rose 0.3%, a 63.9-point premium to the underlying S&P/ASX 200 index
close. The benchmark ended 0.2% higher last week.
